title: Banashak losing Allen Toussaint to Marshall Sehorn
summary: While Toussaint was in service Banashak worked to keep him an artist, then Sehorn won him as partner, leaving Banashak feeling betrayed.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, Marshall Sehon came in and created a new company and Alan left Joe. Remember, Alan went off into service. Right.

Yeah. Well, when he came back, Marshall got him to go be with him, be his partner with him, with Marshall, as opposed to Joe. And I think he felt that that was done in an unfair manner. I don't know whether it was or wasn't, to be honest with you.
So Joe, and I picked that up from him, that he... Yeah, he felt that when Alan came back from the...
Yeah. Because all during the time Alan was in the service, Joe was working hard to try to keep Alan an artist.
Yes. Alan would come in from Texas. Right. Or he went to Texas and whatever, you know. And he felt sort of, I guess, but he never used that word around me, but I think maybe he felt betrayed.
